scheme_name: One-time and Annual Financial Grant to Soldiers Awarded with Gallantry Medals
description:
The One-time and Annual Financial Grant to Soldiers Awarded with Gallantry Medals is a significant welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India. 

This scheme was launched on 26th January 2016. 

It aims to honor and provide financial assistance to soldiers who have been awarded gallantry medals for their bravery and valor in the line of duty. 

The scheme recognizes the sacrifices made by these soldiers and aims to support them and their families. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to provide a one-time financial grant and an annual financial grant to these gallantry awardees. 

The one-time financial grant is set at ₹25 lakh. 

This amount is intended to provide immediate financial support to the soldiers and their families. 

In addition to the one-time grant, an annual financial grant of ₹10,000 is provided to each gallantry awardee. 

This annual grant serves as a recognition of their service and is intended to assist in their ongoing needs. 

The scheme is applicable to all soldiers who have been awarded gallantry medals such as the Param Vir Chakra, Mahavir Chakra, and Vir Chakra. 

Eligibility for this scheme is strictly limited to those who have received these specific gallantry awards. 

There are no age limits for eligibility under this scheme. 

However, the soldier must be a recipient of a gallantry medal awarded by the Government of India. 

The application process for this scheme is straightforward. 

Eligible soldiers or their families must submit an application to the Ministry of Defence. 

The application must include a copy of the gallantry medal award certificate. 

Additionally, applicants must provide their bank account details for the disbursement of funds. 

The application can be submitted online through the official Ministry of Defence website or through designated offices. 

Once the application is received, it is verified by the concerned authorities. 

The verification process ensures that only eligible awardees receive the financial grants. 

The one-time grant is disbursed within three months of the application approval. 

The annual grant is disbursed every year on 15th August, coinciding with Independence Day celebrations. 

This timing is symbolic and reinforces the recognition of the soldiers' contributions to the nation. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. 

The specific department handling the scheme is the Directorate of Military Welfare. 

For any queries or assistance, individuals can contact the Ministry of Defence through their official helpline. 

The helpline number is +91-11-2301-1234. 

The scheme has been well-received and has positively impacted the lives of numerous gallantry awardees. 

As of October 2023, over 1,500 soldiers have benefited from this financial assistance scheme. 

The total amount disbursed under this scheme has exceeded ₹400 crores since its inception. 

This financial support has helped many soldiers in various ways, including medical expenses, education for their children, and other essential needs. 

The scheme also serves to inspire future generations to serve the nation with valor and courage. 

It reinforces the government's commitment to the welfare of armed forces personnel. 

The financial grants provided under this scheme are tax-free. 

This ensures that the full amount reaches the awardees without any deductions. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Indian government to enhance the welfare of armed forces personnel and their families. 

Other related schemes include the Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme and the Armed Forces Battle Casualties Welfare Fund. 

These initiatives collectively aim to provide comprehensive support to soldiers and their families. 

The One-time and Annual Financial Grant to Soldiers Awarded with Gallantry Medals reflects the nation's gratitude towards its armed forces. 

It acknowledges the risks and sacrifices made by soldiers in protecting the sovereignty and integrity of the country. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's recognition of the valor and dedication of its soldiers. 

It encourages a culture of appreciation and respect for those who serve in the armed forces. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is crucial for the welfare of the awardees and their families. 

It ensures that they are not only recognized for their bravery but also supported in their post-service life. 

The scheme is an essential part of India's efforts to honor its heroes. 

It is a step towards ensuring that soldiers who have demonstrated exceptional courage are not left behind. 

The financial grants serve as a reminder of the sacrifices made by these individuals for the nation. 

The government continues to evaluate and improve the scheme to ensure it meets the needs of the awardees. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is actively sought to enhance the effectiveness of the scheme. 

The One-time and Annual Financial Grant to Soldiers Awarded with Gallantry Medals is a critical component of India's commitment to its armed forces. 

It embodies the spirit of gratitude and respect that the nation holds for its brave soldiers. 

The scheme is a vital resource for gallantry awardees and their families, providing them with the support they deserve. 

In conclusion, the One-time and Annual Financial Grant to Soldiers Awarded with Gallantry Medals is a significant welfare initiative. 

It provides substantial financial support to those who have shown extraordinary bravery in service to the nation. 

The scheme is a clear indication of the government's dedication to the welfare of its armed forces personnel. 

It aims to ensure that gallantry awardees receive the recognition and support they need and deserve.
